Description: Date the feedback was captured in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Source channel of the feedback (e.g. Post-Contact Survey, In-App Survey, App Store Review, Play Store Review, Retailer Review, Community, Social).
Product or experience area referenced by the feedback.
Specific Jonly product mentioned or associated with the feedback.
Rating score given by the customer in the feedback (1 = very dissatisfied, 5 = very satisfied).
Derived sentiment score for the feedback text or interaction, normalized approximately between -1 (very negative) and 1 (very positive).
Net Promoter Score value (0, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10) for survey-style sources; may be NULL for reviews or non-NPS channels.
Foreign key referencing contact_cases.case_id when the feedback is tied to a specific support case; NULL when not linked.
Free-text feedback left by the customer, often referencing the Jonly brand, specific products, and product areas.
